d.ko: Don’t Starve is an uncompromising wilderness survival game full of science and magic. Enter a strange and unexplored world full of strange creatures, dangers, and surprises. Gather resources to craft items and structures that match your survival style.
d.en: Don’t Starve is an uncompromising wilderness survival game full of science and magic. Enter a strange and unexplored world full of strange creatures, dangers, and surprises. Gather resources to craft items and structures that match your survival style.
d.zh: 《饥荒》是一款绝不妥协的荒野生存游戏，游戏世界充满了科学与魔法。你将踏入一个未被探索的陌生世界，那里遍布奇异生物、危险与惊喜。收集资源，制作物品、建造建筑，玩出属于你自己的求生风格。
